items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: When Larry left we had John VonBergen.

ctx.x: So we had a bass player. When Larry left we had John VonBergen. And then I got Emerson Brown and then we got Collier and we had a Dixieland band.
Neat. Do you have favorite Dixieland musicians yourself?
